# Fixture provenance

Most fixtures in this directory are small synthetic documents whose scanner
names and data are clearly fictional. The following fixture is copied unchanged
from a public upstream project:

| Fixture             | Upstream source                                                                                                                                                                                            | Commit                                     | SHA-256                                                            | License    |
| ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------- |
| `cyclonedx-vex.xml` | [CycloneDX specification `valid-vulnerability-1.4.xml`](https://github.com/CycloneDX/specification/blob/970eeb2995c16ea95124a224b7defc351dd563bd/tools/src/test/resources/1.4/valid-vulnerability-1.4.xml) | `970eeb2995c16ea95124a224b7defc351dd563bd` | `5EBF19158B6E7C9A134B8CBFEC0BEA6A87682F700EDCD153CBE470958D0F00D2` | Apache-2.0 |

The upstream fixture is test data, not a claim about a live vulnerable system.
